page.layout: One column of running text, set in a single block. No marginal notes, no catchword, no signature.

main_text.l: alijsque sacris ordinibus institutis apud Im-
peratores diutius moras agere, decreto ta-
men Imperatoris hoc absque periculo fieri,
& quod eis imperatur, exercebunt, vt ne-
que Imperatori quicquam possit imputari,
si eos accersat, neq; ij rei futuri sunt, vt qui
iubenti Imperatori acquiescant. In Ba-
ptismo post cereum accensum exhibitum
Baptizatis, sequebatur lactis, & mellis de-
gustatio, quam olim vsitatam fuisse testa-
tur Tertullianus de corona militis capi-
te 3. Hieronymus citat aduersus Luciferia-
nos. Verum hæc cerimonia in desuetudi-
nem abijt. Vide plura apud Vasquez Dis-
putatione 166. cap. 6. & Henriquez lib. 2,
cap. 13. Canon Trullanus septuagesimus se-
cundus præcipit, si ex infidelibus coniugi-
bus alteruter fidem fuerit amplexus, & in-
fideli cum fideli habitare placeat, non esse
segregandos iuxta Pauli vocem. Sub Pa-
triarcha tamen Theodosio buccinator qui-
dam Imperatorius baptizatus, per scriptu-
ram Patriarchicam separatus est, quæ me-
rito non obtemperabat multum roganti, vt
religionem suam ampletteretur, id quod
Canoni contrarium est, adnotat nescio
quis in Harmenopuli Epitome Canon. fec.5.
Tit. 2. Plura hic adderem, sed si cui hæc
non sufficiunt, neque sexcenta alia suffece-
rint.

page.notes: Page number printed at the top as "430" (the o is a small superscript form). No running head. The printed word "suffecerint" is split across the line end as "suffece-" / "rint." and is written whole with its printed hyphen. "Canon. fec.5." is copied as printed; the first letter looks like a long s, which is written plain as "s" by the rules, but I left the letters as seen because I cannot confirm them. The right edge of the scan shows only the page edge and no text, so no margin notes are recorded.
